version_report_description: Describe the problem. The launcher will attach its application log, this build's metadata, latest game log, launch diagnostics, latest crash report, and latest hs_err log when available. Access tokens and home-directory paths are redacted.
version_report_message_hint: What happened, what you launched, and which actions happened before the issue...
version_report_message_required: Describe the problem before sending the report
version_crashed_open_logs: Minecraft closed with an error. Open diagnostics to inspect the latest log or crash report: {path}
launch_diagnostic_missing_minecraft: The log says Minecraft classes are missing. The launcher will try to restore the base component on the next start; if it repeats, reinstall this build.
launch_diagnostic_graphics: The log contains a graphics initialization or driver failure. Update the GPU driver; if the diagnostics name a renderer mod, try updating or temporarily disabling that mod.
launch_diagnostic_vulkan_gpu_title: VulkanMod could not find a compatible GPU
launch_diagnostic_vulkan_gpu: VulkanMod did not find a graphics device with the required Vulkan support. Update the GPU driver or update, reconfigure, or disable VulkanMod; this is not a Sodium dependency error.
launch_diagnostic_mod_incompatibility: The mod loader stopped before launch because installed mod versions conflict. Update or replace the mods listed in the diagnostics; changing the graphics driver will not fix this conflict.
launch_diagnostic_player_interaction: The game accessed the inventory before the local player finished loading. Check or update the interaction and control mods named in the stack trace; Sodium and the graphics driver are not confirmed causes of this failure.
launch_diagnostic_missing_mod_dependency: The log points to a missing or corrupted required mod. The launcher will force a repair sync before the next start; close any running Minecraft windows if synchronization reports locked files.
launch_diagnostic_channel_mismatch_title: Client and server mod list differ
launch_diagnostic_channel_mismatch: The server requires a mod channel that is missing on the client. Restore the removed mod or resync the pack.
launch_diagnostic_locked_file: Another Minecraft process or antivirus is holding a pack file. Close running games and retry synchronization.
launch_diagnostic_ftb_chunks_title: FTB Chunks local map data failed
launch_diagnostic_ftb_chunks: FTB Chunks crashed while saving its local map regions. Close Minecraft, back up the instance, and clear only this instance's local FTB Chunks map cache; do not remove server-side claims or chunk data.
launch_diagnostic_create_rendering: Create/Ponder could not build the model for a block entity. Update Create, Ponder, and related add-ons; if it happens only near one block, that block or its cached model data may need repair. This is not a GPU driver diagnosis.
launch_diagnostic_create_rendering_block: Create/Ponder could not build the model for {block}. Update the Create add-on that provides this block together with Create and Ponder; the block or its cached model data may also need repair. This is not a GPU driver diagnosis.
launch_diagnostic_create_configuration_t: Create network payload ran too early
launch_diagnostic_create_configuration: Create/Ponder handled a server payload before the client player finished loading. Resync the pack, then update the matching Create, Ponder, and NeoForge versions on both client and server if it repeats. This is not a missing Minecraft installation or GPU driver issue.
launch_diagnostic_unknown: The launcher captured logs for this failed launch. Open diagnostics or send a report for deeper inspection.
launch_diagnostic_multiple: The diagnostics also found {count} independent problems. They will be included in the report.
diagnostic_repair_confirm_message: Close running Minecraft windows first. The launcher will verify and synchronize the build, then start it when the repair succeeds.
